newsitem.title: CANADA: Southam offers to buy 60 pct of Post-report.
newsitem.headline: Southam offers to buy 60 pct of Post-report.

text.p: Southam Inc has offered to buy 60 percent of the Financial Post daily newspaper, the Canadian Press reported late on Thursday.

CP said the offer came days before shareholders in Toronto Sun Publishing Corp vote on a C$16 a share bid from employees and institutional investors. Toronto Sun owns newspapers across Canada and 60 percent of the Post.

Rogers Communications Inc, which owns 63 percent of Toronto Sun, accepted the employee-led bid but reserved until November 8 the right to accept a rival bid above C$16.50 a share. Southam officials were unavailable for comment.
